title: REVOLUTION MEN'S LEAGUE | WEEK 2 RECAP
content: Week 2 was a gritty grind for the Revolution Men's Fall League. Matt Spear poured in 31 points to keep Pink unbeaten. Red raced to a 25-point halftime lead on its way to become 2-0. Will Oboh lit up the scoreboard with 24 to lift Blue past White, and Fab Anthony's double-double steered Green past Orange. Let's get into the action.

games.text: Gray was hungry for its first win. Gray played with grit and got a boost from a hot hand. Jimmy Warden attacked the rim and buried some deep threes, while Jaren Jeffcoat muscled his way to work inside. Jeromy Anderson crashed the glass beside him. Pink hung close behind Matt Spear's strength in the paint, but Gray carried a four-point edge into the break after a wild spurt that ended with Warden burying a 33-footer off the glass before the buzzer. Halftime: Gray 40, Pink 36. The second half belonged to Pink. Matt Spear took over like a runaway train. He finished 14-of-25 from the field for 31 points, and Liam Walsh added 19 and grabbed 11 rebounds. Paul Gutierrez splashed all three of his three-point tries, but Cory Chaplin also found his range from deep. Gray eventually went cold, scoring just 26 points after the break, and Pink outscored them by 13 in the half. Pink pulled away for a 75-66 win.

performers.Gray: Jimmy Warden — 20 pts, 5 reb, 1 ast; Cory Chaplin — 19 pts, 1 reb, 1 ast, 1 blk; Jaren Jeffcoat — 18 pts, 13 reb, 5 ast
performers.Pink: Matt Spear — 31 pts, 10 reb, 4 ast, 2 stl; Liam Walsh — 19 pts, 11 reb, 1 ast; Paul Gutierrez — 13 pts, 3 reb, 1 ast

games.text: Red burst out of the gate like a sprinter. Drew Pelkey carved up the defense with an array of moves. Alex Philo and Cam Perta let it fly from deep, and the nets kept snapping. Logan Letourneau owned the glass and picked pockets on defense — holding Black to just 19 points in the opening half. Red's lead ballooned to 25 by half. Halftime: Red 44, Black 19. Black refused to fold after the break. Matt Riordan led the charge. He went 10-of-12 from the field and finished with 21 points; Aiden Brown knocked down three triples; and Brody Snow chipped in 11 points and seven rebounds. Harvey Merrill dished three assists. Black outscored Red 37-32 in the second half, but the early hole was too deep to escape. Red coasted to a 76-56 win.

performers.Black: Matt Riordan — 21 pts, 5 reb, 4 ast, 1 stl; Aiden Brown — 11 pts, 4 reb, 1 ast; Brody Snow — 11 pts, 7 reb, 2 ast
performers.Red: Drew Pelkey — 27 pts, 9 reb, 3 ast; Alex Philo — 19 pts, 6 reb; Logan Letourneau — 14 pts, 13 reb, 4 ast, 4 stl

games.text: White drew first blood. Asko Mostarlic and Andy Bousono supplied a scoring punch. Meanwhile, Aid Semic hammered away on the boards. Blue stayed in the fight behind Kyle Picard's steady touch. White held a 40-37 lead at the break, though it was a slim one. Halftime: White 40, Blue 37. Blue tightened the screws after the break. Will Oboh hit four threes on his way to 24 points. Kyle Picard added 16, and Kolby Bradford gave Blue 12 tough points. Will Ewald also grabbed 11 rebounds and four steals to go along with his 10 points. White's offense sputtered, managing just 24 points in the half, so Blue outscored White 31-24 to steal the win. Blue rallied to beat White, 68-64.

performers.Blue: Will Oboh — 24 pts, 7 reb, 1 stl, 1 blk; Kyle Picard — 16 pts, 5 reb, 1 ast; Will Ewald — 10 pts, 11 reb, 1 ast, 4 stl
performers.White: Asko Mostarlic — 22 pts, 8 reb, 1 stl; Andy Bousono — 17 pts, 6 reb, 3 ast; Aid Semic — 9 pts, 12 reb, 1 stl

games.text: Green came to bounce back. Fab Anthony anchored the paint, and Dennis Schut hit three triples, as John O'Brien added two more from deep. Kenny Black vacuumed up rebounds. Orange stayed within reach behind Kyle Haley's scoring, but Green slipped ahead 33-30 at the break. Halftime: Green 33, Orange 30. Orange pushed back after intermission, but the shots would not fall. Kyle Haley kept Orange afloat with 27 points. Edo Semic buried five threes, and Kerry Lyons went 5-for-5 at the line while pulling down 11 rebounds. Still, Brandon Boyer went 2-of-14, and Orange shot just 22-of-66 as a team. Green matched every push and outscored Orange 37-30 after the break. Green sealed a 70-60 victory.

performers.Orange: Kyle Haley — 27 pts, 5 reb, 1 ast; Edo Semic — 15 pts, 4 reb, 1 stl; Kerry Lyons — 14 pts, 11 reb, 4 ast, 1 stl
